Priya (CS): Hey @Carlos — quick item from your vendor-security questionnaire: your answers indicate payment processing touches our API. Can you confirm whether Redwood ever receives raw card numbers (PAN) or only payment-provider tokens?
Nina (Security): If it's token-only, that's usually out of PCI scope for us. Important follow-ups: are tokens persisted anywhere, and are they ever present in logs, traces, or support tickets?
Carlos (Customer): We only proxy Stripe tokens to Redwood. We don't share raw PANs. In prod logs tokens are redacted. There is a staging debug mode that can include full request bodies.
Ethan (Solutions): That staging debug flag is common. For the questionnaire we need an infra attestation stating debug mode is disabled in production and that production logs redact tokens. Also include token retention policy.
Priya (CS): Suggested attestation text we can paste: "We do not send or store raw PANs. Only payment-provider tokens (Stripe tokens) are provided to third parties. Production logs redact payment tokens; staging debug mode that captures full request bodies is disabled in production and controlled via infra-only feature flags with audited access. Token TTL: 7 days."
Nina (Security): Add one more line: who can enable debug and what approval/audit exists. Auditors expect a short chain-of-custody. Also include whether tokens are ever copied into ticketing systems.
Carlos (Customer): Infra confirmed: prod flag inaccessible to CS/support, only SRE with a JIRA ticket and manager approval can flip it for emergency, and all toggles are logged. Tokens are never copied into Jira — we redact before creating support tickets.
OnboardBot: Reminder: attach the signed infra attestation to ticket ONB-901 before marking the vendor-form complete.
Priya (CS): Great — once Carlos attaches the infra-signed statement I'll finalize the vendor form reply and send to Legal. This will mark PCI out-of-scope for onboarding and reduce renewal risk.
Carlos (Customer): I'll get infra to sign and upload by EOD.
Ethan (Solutions): Thanks — if infra can paste the redaction regex or a one-line example (e.g., token -> <REDACTED>) that helps the auditor.
Priya (CS): Noted, I'll include that in the reply. Thanks everyone!
